input: Temperature sensor on Line 3 is reading -40C intermittently, looks like a wiring fault.
expected_summary: Line 3 temperature sensor giving intermittent faulty readings, likely a wiring issue.

input: PLC lost connection to the HMI panel twice this morning, dropped out for about 10 seconds each time.
expected_summary: PLC-to-HMI connection dropped out twice this morning for about 10 seconds each time.

input: Conveyor belt motor #2 is grinding loudly and vibrating more than usual.
expected_summary: Conveyor belt motor #2 is grinding and vibrating abnormally.

input: Daily inspection complete, all systems within normal parameters, no anomalies noted.
expected_summary: Daily inspection found all systems operating normally.

input: gearbox making a weird grinding noise and the pressure sensor reading also looks off, not sure which is the real problem
expected_summary: Gearbox noise reported alongside an abnormal pressure sensor reading; root cause unclear.
notes: Ambiguous: touches both mechanical_fault and sensor_fault. Treated as mechanical_fault since the physical noise is the primary symptom.

input: presure sensr on tank 2 giving weird readigns since this morning, might be brokn
expected_summary: Tank 2 pressure sensor giving abnormal readings since this morning, possibly faulty.
notes: Heavy typos in input; tests robustness to noisy free text.

input: oh great, the robot arm decided to just stop responding to commands again, cool cool cool, no errors logged either
expected_summary: Robot arm stopped responding to commands with no errors logged.
notes: Sarcastic tone. Core issue is a command/communication failure with the arm, not a physical symptom, so it's communication_error rather than mechanical_fault.

input: Der Temperatursensor an Linie 3 zeigt seit heute Morgen komische Werte, konnte defekt sein.
expected_summary: Line 3 temperature sensor showing unusual readings since this morning, possibly defective.
notes: Report written in German. Should classify the same as an equivalent English report — tests multilingual handling.

input: No comms from PLC-7 since 09:14, panel shows offline.
expected_summary: PLC-7 offline with no communication since 09:14.

input: Yesterday's sensor glitch on Line 2 hasn't recurred, everything's been steady since, closing this out.
expected_summary: Line 2 sensor issue from yesterday has not recurred; systems have been steady since.
notes: Mentions a past fault but current status is nominal — tests whether the classifier over-indexes on fault keywords instead of overall status.

input: Vibration levels on Pump 4 hit 12.4 mm/s, above the 10 mm/s ISO threshold, bearing wear suspected.
expected_summary: Pump 4 vibration exceeded the ISO threshold, suspected bearing wear.

input: Modbus TCP timeout errors spiking on PLC-7, packet loss around 30 percent.
expected_summary: PLC-7 experiencing Modbus TCP timeouts with roughly 30% packet loss.

input: Everything seems okay but I noticed slight jitter in the encoder feedback, probably nothing.
expected_summary: Minor jitter noticed in encoder feedback; otherwise the system appears normal.
notes: Borderline nominal-vs-fault. The report downplays the issue but still describes a sensor anomaly, not a clean bill of health.

input: Bearing on the main drive shaft is overheating and smells like burning rubber.
expected_summary: Main drive shaft bearing is overheating with a burning smell.

input: cant tell if its the network or the actuator, arm moves late and sometimes not at all, no error codes
expected_summary: Robotic arm responding late or not at all, with no error codes logged.
notes: Genuinely ambiguous between communication_error and mechanical_fault. Labeled communication_error because delayed/missing response with zero error codes points more toward a comms/timing issue than a hard mechanical failure — but mechanical_fault is a defensible alternative answer. Good candidate to revisit once you have real-world labeled data.

input: Flow meter FM-2 stuck at 0.0 L/min even though the pump is clearly running.
expected_summary: Flow meter FM-2 reads zero despite the pump visibly running.

input: Profinet connection to the weld robot dropping every few minutes, error 0x8004 on the panel.
expected_summary: Weld robot's Profinet connection drops intermittently with error 0x8004.

input: Drive belt on conveyor 5 is frayed at the edges and slipping under load.
expected_summary: Conveyor 5 drive belt is frayed and slipping under load.

input: Weekly PM completed on Line 1, lubrication topped up, all readings in spec.
expected_summary: Line 1 weekly preventive maintenance completed with all readings within spec.

input: level sensr tank 7 readin 110% full which aint possible, probly failed agin
expected_summary: Tank 7 level sensor reporting an impossible 110% reading, likely failed again.
notes: Heavy typos and informal grammar; tests robustness to noisy free text.

input: plc7 offline
expected_summary: PLC-7 is offline.
notes: Extremely terse two-word report; tests behavior on minimal input.

input: Thermocouple TC-4 on the oven reads a constant 25C regardless of setpoint, suspect open junction.
expected_summary: Oven thermocouple TC-4 stuck at a constant reading, suspected open junction.

input: Sensor says furnace zone 2 is at 260C and the handheld IR gun confirms it — the zone really is overheating.
expected_summary: Furnace zone 2 is genuinely overheating, confirmed by an independent measurement.
notes: Mentions a sensor but the sensor is explicitly verified as accurate — the fault is the physical overheating, not the measurement. Tests whether the model over-indexes on the word 'sensor'.

input: No data coming from the vibration probe on channel 3, cable in the junction box looks chewed.
expected_summary: Vibration probe on channel 3 delivering no data, likely damaged cabling.
notes: A single measurement device failing to deliver readings is sensor_fault (missing readings), even though wiring is involved. Contrast with case_025 where the whole network layer is implicated.

input: Gateway shows every sensor on Line 2 offline at once since the network switch rebooted.
expected_summary: All Line 2 sensors went offline simultaneously after a network switch reboot.
notes: Simultaneous loss of ALL devices after a switch event points to the transport layer, not the sensors themselves. Paired discriminator with case_024.

input: Main spindle bearing running hot, smells like burnt grease near the housing.
expected_summary: Main spindle bearing overheating with a burnt grease smell.

input: Der Drucksensor an Tank 4 liefert seit dem Schichtwechsel keine Werte mehr.
expected_summary: Tank 4 pressure sensor has delivered no values since the shift change.

input: Die Verbindung zur SPS bricht seit heute früh ständig ab, Panel zeigt Timeout.
expected_summary: Connection to the PLC has been dropping repeatedly since this morning, panel shows timeouts.

input: Anlage lief in der Nachtschicht stabil, keine Störungen oder Auffälligkeiten.
expected_summary: System ran stably through the night shift with no faults or anomalies.

input: Das Getriebe on line 2 makes komische Geräusche beim Anfahren, sounds like metal on metal.
expected_summary: Line 2 gearbox making abnormal metal-on-metal noises during startup.
notes: Mixed German/English in one sentence — realistic for a German plant with international staff.
